resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (libyasummit.com, dead) recovered as a Wayback capture (2024-06-14) of the same live article: confirms Libya is 'spearheading several new pipeline projects – including the 130-km NC 41-Mellitah Gas project to commence from 2025 and owned by Eni and the NOC.' Independently, Offshore Technology/GlobalData's dedicated NC 41-Mellitah Gas pipeline profile describes it as 'upcoming' and 'expected to commence operations in 2025.' Neither source prints the literal word 'construction', but both independently confirm the pipeline as a named, owned, dated (2025), committed infrastructure project actively being developed rather than merely proposed/conceptual — status inferred as construction per standard practice (a reasonable reader concludes construction-stage from a dated, owned, in-development project). CAVEAT TO FLAG: I found no source (English/Arabic/Italian) independently confirming an actual construction/pipe-laying milestone specifically for this 130km/30in NC-41-Mellitah segment (as distinct from the offshore Structures A&E development or the Sabratha compression project, which are separately documented and have their own pipelines). Confirmed this source is genuinely about THIS line (30in, 130km, Bay of Tripoli to Nuqat Al-Khams) and not the separate P6715 E Structure-Mellitah line (36in, ~30km, Structure E to existing Sabratha-Mellitah pipeline) or the unrelated 42in Intisar A/103-to-Brega pipeline (also 130km, trialled April 2026 per Ecofin/PGJ) that surfaced in searches and is a different project entirely.

Fuel=Gas is directly and explicitly confirmed by both independent sources: the Wayback capture of the original libyasummit.com article calls it the '130-km NC 41-Mellitah Gas project', and Offshore Technology's dedicated profile page for 'NC 41-Mellitah Gas' classifies it throughout as a natural gas pipeline. No ambiguity.

PipelineType=transmission is a GEM taxonomy classification (transmission vs. gathering vs. distribution), not a term sources use verbatim. Offshore Technology's profile describes a 130km, 30in-diameter trunk line carrying gas between two named points (Bay of Tripoli area and Nuqat Al-Khams/Mellitah) — a long-haul line-haul pipeline is the standard basis for a 'transmission' classification, as opposed to a short field-gathering line. Only one source gives the specific route/diameter needed to support this classification directly (the libyasummit.com piece confirms the project exists and its length/date but not diameter/route), so staged at medium/single-source per the confidence-tier convention rather than left blank.

StartYear1=2025 is directly and independently confirmed by both sources: libyasummit.com (Wayback, Dec 2023) says the project is 'to commence from 2025'; Offshore Technology/GlobalData separately says it is 'expected to commence operations in 2025.' Note (context only, not changing the value): today is 2026-07-23 and I found no independent report confirming the pipeline actually reached operations in 2025 as planned — consistent with the sheet's separate Delayed/DelayType=inferred flag on this same row.

DelayType=inferred is a GEM-side inference (StartYear1=2025 has passed with no independent confirmation the line reached operations), not a value any news source states or could state. Searched English/Arabic/Italian coverage (Eni, NOC, Mellitah Oil & Gas, Offshore Technology, Ecofin Agency, Pipeline & Gas Journal, alwasat.ly, attaqa.net, africaoilgasreport.com) through mid-2026 for an explicit delay/postponement announcement, completion announcement, or updated timeline specific to this 130km/30in NC-41-Mellitah line; found none — only the original 2023 'to commence from 2025' framing recurs, with no follow-up. Left UNRESOLVED per instructions (no fabricated URL for a status GEM itself infers).

LengthKnown=130.00 km is explicitly and independently confirmed by both sources: libyasummit.com (Wayback capture) names 'the 130-km NC 41-Mellitah Gas project'; Offshore Technology/GlobalData's dedicated profile separately states 'the 130km-long, upcoming NC 41-Mellitah Gas project.' Verified this 130km figure belongs to THIS line and not the confusable 42in/130km Intisar A/103-to-Brega pipeline (trial run reported by Ecofin Agency and Pipeline & Gas Journal, April 2026) or the offshore Structures A&E 30km/36in pipeline to the existing Sabratha-Mellitah line (P6715, E Structure-Mellitah) — those have different diameters, endpoints and are reported separately.

StartState/Province='Bay of Tripoli' / StartCountryOrArea='Libya' / EndPrefecture/District='Nuqat Al-Khams' / EndCountryOrArea='Libya' are explicitly stated on Offshore Technology's dedicated NC 41-Mellitah Gas profile ('will start in Bay of Tripoli (Libya) and ends in Nuqat Al-Khams (Libya)'), consistent with the pipeline terminating at the Mellitah complex, which sits in Nuqat al-Khums district. This is the only source I could verify giving the specific start/end points for this particular line (as opposed to the block/field-level 'NC-41' or 'Bahr Essalam' location descriptions, which are ~110-125km NW of Tripoli offshore and are for the field, not this pipeline). Could not find a second independent source naming both endpoints for this specific line despite searching Eni, NOC, Mellitah Oil & Gas, MEED, Rigzone, and Arabic/Italian outlets — staged at medium/single-source per the confidence-tier convention rather than left blank.
